title: 第7章 回归第8章 吞噬魔核
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
王路和叶成将遁地鼠身上值钱的部分给回收了。
到时候回到村子里还能卖出不少价钱。
甚至还有一只魔兽爆出了一颗魔核。
魔核的价值就更高了，因为可以用来炼丹炼器布阵。
丘凌风则是替张悦处理起了伤口。
虽然不致命，但是也影响了接下来张悦的战斗力。
“接下来要格外小心了。”
王路开口说道，
“尤其是凌风你，一定要保证自身安全。”
拥有天赋神通的武者，未来前途不可限量。
可不能死在了这小小的暗森林里。
“嗯，我会小心的。”
丘凌风温和一笑，点头道。
“凌风，你的神通天赋还能使用吧？”
王路问道。
“不清楚，不过那神通天赋对我的消耗还是很大的，现在我的脑袋还有点刺疼发胀。”
丘凌风摇头道。
他能感觉到，他最多再施展一次神通天赋就会力竭。
他现在只是通脉境三段的修为，这种修为还是太低了。
目前还无法随心所欲的使用神通天赋。

这一次丘凌风倒是没有选择吞噬遁地鼠。
他还真的怕王路几人联想到昨晚的事情与他有关。
自己身怀系统这件事情，还是不要暴露的好。
“可惜了，这三只遁地鼠都被冻坏了，没有什么可以拿的了。”
王路看了一眼地上的那三只遁地鼠，叹了一口气道。
这三只遁地鼠，正是中了冰封天眸的遁地鼠。
“系统，我能吞噬那三只遁地鼠吗？”
丘凌风眼睛一亮，问道。
【叮咚，宿主吞噬遁地鼠尸体x3。】
【恭喜宿主获得土系二阶奴仆魔核一枚。】
【恭喜宿主获得神通天赋：巨力爪。】
【恭喜宿主修为晋升：通脉境四段。】
【恭喜宿主获得40吞噬点。】
看来系统倒是不在乎这些。
因为那三只遁地鼠的尸体被冻坏了，所以也没有人注意到丘凌风吞噬了这三只遁地鼠。
【巨力爪：提升宿主双臂力量三倍，持续五秒钟。】
content_en:
Wang Lu and Ye Cheng recovered the valuable parts of the gopher.
When the time comes, you can still sell it for a lot of money when you return to the village.
There was even a demonic beast that exploded with a magic core.
The value of the magic core is even higher, because it can be used to refine elixirs and weapons to form formations.
Qiu Lingfeng treated Zhang Yue's wounds.
Although it is not fatal, it also affects Zhang Yue's combat effectiveness in the future.
"You have to be extra careful next time."
Wang Lu said,
"Especially Lingfeng, you must ensure your own safety."
Warriors with innate magical powers have an unlimited future.
We can't die in this small dark forest.
"Well, I'll be careful."
Qiu Lingfeng smiled gently and nodded.
"Ling Feng, can you still use your magical talent?"
Wang Lu asked.
"I don't know, but that magical talent still consumes a lot of money on me. Now my head is still a little tingly, painful and swollen."
Qiu Lingfeng shook his head.
He could feel that he would be exhausted if he could use his magical talent only once more.
He is only at the third level of Tongmai Realm, which is still too low.
At present, it is not possible to use magical talents as desired.
This time, Qiu Lingfeng did not choose to devour the Escape Rat.
He was really afraid that Wang Lu and others would think that what happened last night was related to him.
It's better not to expose the fact that you are pregnant with the system.
"It's a pity that these three gopher rats are all frozen, and there is nothing left to take."
Wang Lu glanced at the three escape rats on the ground and sighed.
These three escaping rats are the escaping rats that were hit by the Frozen Sky Eyes.
"System, can I swallow those three escaping rats?"
Qiu Lingfeng's eyes lit up and he asked.
[Ding dong, the host devoured the corpse of the gopher x3. 】
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a second-level earth-type slave demon core. 】
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the magical talent: Giant Claw. 】
[Congratulations to the host for his promotion to the fourth level of Tongmai Realm. 】
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining 40 devouring points. 】
It seems that the system doesn't care about this.
Because the corpses of the three ground rats were frozen, no one noticed that Qiu Lingfeng devoured the three ground rats.
[Giant Claw: Increases the strength of the host's arms by three times, lasting for five seconds. 】
